newsitem.title: USA: Environmental Technologies ends talks to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Environmental Technologies ends talks to sell unit.

text.p: Environmental Technologies USA Inc said Wednesday that discussions have ended to sell its Clean Green Packing Company of Minnesota subsidiary to Absorption Corp.
Absorption is a unit of International Absorbents Inc.
International Absorbents signed a letter of intent in June to acquire the business of Clean Green Packing for a consideration of cash and warrants. Terms of the offer had not been disclosed.
Environmental Technologies did not specify the reasons why talks broke off. The company was not immediately available for comment.
